summary: SPAR Group filed an 8-K reporting that its special meeting of stockholders on July 6, 2026, was adjourned due to lack of quorum; the meeting will reconvene on July 10, 2026. No business was conducted. The filing does not disclose the specific proposals or any terms; it merely provides procedural notice of the adjournment. No price, stake, premium, or advisor is mentioned. This is a routine procedural filing regarding a stockholder meeting, not a special-situations event. The adjournment itself is not a transformative corporate event.
